WHY: Both reviewers rated this NIT. gemini says a failed run could put a truncated or corrupt index into the prompt prefix (confidence 4). minimax says today's code is safe, because the Python buffers its output and writes it only at the end (line 592), so the risk is a future regression. minimax adds that no test covers a partial write followed by a non-zero exit (confidence 2). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the finding: emit_agents_index writes to its own temporary file and prints only when the exit code is 0 (lines 379 and 594-598). - scripts/build_static_context.sh:62-63 | severity=low | confidence=4 flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3] PROBLEM: The header comment documents the log line as "STATIC_CONTEXT_SIZE phase= mode=index|inline bytes=". The code at line 221 emits `phase=${phase}`, and the changelog and plan line 124 also include the phase value. WHY: Both reviewers rated this NIT. An operator who copies the grep pattern from the comment will not match the emitted log line. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same mismatch only as hardening suggestions: document "phase=clarify|plan" (1 line). === END CONSENSUS FINDINGS === === CONSENSUS TASK GAPS === - requirement: Plan D3, which the issue makes authoritative, says the index must list "all ##/### headings, plus bullet-level entries for the 6 sections over 30 KB, with line ranges". This PR makes the index the default for clarify and plan (line 175, and the workflow fallback `'index'`) without adding the D3 granularity. On this repo's agents.md, `## Workflow architecture` is at L39 and the next `##` is at L1674, so a lookup means reading about 1,635 lines. The PR does not record that it diverges from D3. No hunk adds the D3 granularity, and the PR does not record the divergence. The issue makes D3 authoritative for this phase, and this PR is the first to send the index to clarify and plan.
